result.stdout:
ussfc 1.4.1.2 - Universal Silent Setup Finder / Console

Usage:
  ussfc [options] <file_path>
  <data> | ussfc [options]

Arguments:
  <file_path>   Path to the installer or file to analyze.

Options:
  --json        Output result as JSON instead of human-readable text.
  --help, -h    Show this help message.
  --version, -v Show version information.

Supported file types:
  .inf   Information / Installation file
  .reg   Registry file
  .msi   Windows Installer package
  .exe   Executables (NSIS, Inno Setup, InstallShield, Wise, 7-Zip, WinZip, UPX, etc.)

Examples:
  ussfc setup.exe
  ussfc --json setup.msi
  cat setup.exe | ussfc --json
